sections.title: A background clause for your story
sections.content: amikor ("when") links a background clause to your main story, exactly the way you'd expect from English — Amikor Bécsben voltam, gyönyörű volt az idő. sets up the moment before you get to what actually happened. The amikor-clause can lead, with a comma right after it, or follow the main clause instead — either order is natural.

sections.title: amikor, either way round
rows: Amikor Bécsben voltam, gyönyörű volt az idő.
When I was in Vienna, the weather was gorgeous.
It was raining when we set off.
Amikor külföldön voltunk, sok szép helyet láttunk.
When we were abroad, we saw a lot of beautiful places.

sections.content: The comma always sits between the two clauses, whichever one comes first: Amikor Bécsben voltam, gyönyörű volt az idő needs it right after voltam, but Esett az eső, amikor elindultunk needs it right before amikor instead.
